description: Configure a development container for team environment consistency. Create a .devcontainer directory in the project root at /home/ga/workspace/team-project/ with a devcontainer.json file. The configuration must include: (1) Base image: use 'mcr.microsoft.com/devcontainers/javascript-node:18' in the 'image' field, (2) Container name: set 'name' field to 'team-project-dev', (3) Required extensions in 'customizations.vscode.extensions' array: 'dbaeumer.vscode-eslint', 'esbenp.prettier-vscode', 'eamodio.gitlens', (4) Post-create command: set 'postCreateCommand' field to 'npm install', (5) Editor settings in 'customizations.vscode.settings': enable 'editor.formatOnSave' set to true, and set Prettier as default JavaScript formatter using '[javascript]' with 'editor.defaultFormatter' set to 'esbenp.prettier-vscode'. Finally, create a README_DEVCONTAINER.md file in the project root with instructions for team members on how to use the devcontainer (mention 'Reopen in Container' feature and benefits of consistent environments). This ensures all team members work in identical containerized environments, eliminating 'works on my machine' problems.
